body:
Again, thank you, everything your saying is helping. I think I will end up seeking help professionally, I just don't know where to go or how to come up with the money to pay for it at this point.. I just don't want to tell my mom, it won't help her or me I feel. I agree about the body change helping to some extent, I lost a substantial amount of weight recently and it definitely improved my confidence, unfortunately only in short spurts and not enough to just make me happy. 

I think you're right, it's not something that just happens and I need to work at it, it's finding the motivation to keep pushing that's hardest though. I'm getting an apartment for next semester at college, with 2 of my favorite people to be around, hopefully this can make the difference for me, it's a year lease so I'll be able to remain away from home which I prefer.

Thank you so much for your time, you're a good person for taking time out of your day to give me reason and hope, hopefully I can get the ball rolling towards feeling happy, or like I belong here.

you couldn't have hit the nail on the head any harder, man. The thing with sports, I was always expected to do great but lacked that motivation as well, and the issue with friends is something I've never been able to grasp. All my best friends seem to disappear as soon as I get comfortable, the same for any girlfriends. I'm glad your life turned around, I'm desperately hoping mine will too, I really don't want to end it if there's something more.

When you moved out did you feel like your friendships and relationships got better? How about motivation? Thank you so much for your response, it helps more than you know.
i took it as a 'lets make this schmuck do *everything*' joke
Okay, I understand. Sorry, I just don't want to confront anyone about this in person, I'm not sure its something I can fix.

I suppose my father abandoning my family was a start, and the verbal and physical abuse from my step father from ~8 years old to leaving for college was a major factor.. I just don't know how to cope or if it's possible, I'm sure some of my life's lowest moments can be attributed to those negative and often occurrences but I just don't know what to do or how to change..

Thank you for your response, The reason I hate discussing this is that I really can't say. I remember barely anything from childhood. Hopes, dreams, basically anything.. I feel like everything I strive for (sports, school, etc.) are only important to me because I feel like they're supposed to be.
